newsitem.title: UK: Two Brent cargoes left unclaimed at deadline-trade.
newsitem.headline: Two Brent cargoes left unclaimed at deadline-trade.

text.p: Two of five sets of Brent cargo dates were left unclaimed on Friday at the five o'clock deadline, said traders.
One of the two five o'clocked cargoes was in dispute while the other, loading Jan 20-22, was left with Shell, they added.
Of the three cargoes kept, Shell kept two, loading Jan 18-20 and 20-22, while BP kept a Jan 18-20 loader.
Confirmation from the companies was not immediately available.
